note: Conceptual/architecture lesson applying the general defense-in-depth security principle to a Salesforce org, mapping it onto the boundary layers introduced in Lesson 1. Taught through a layer table and a worked scenario, no screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. Defense in depth itself is a general enterprise-security-architecture concept, not a Salesforce-specific feature claim; the Salesforce-specific layer names (Transaction Security Policies, Shield Platform Encryption, Field Audit Trail) are each verified individually in their own dedicated lessons later in this course.
